$schema: Commands registry — single source of truth for all slash commands

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Connect to a server and namespace

commands.name: list
commands.description: List documents in the namespace (cls, mac, inc)

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Pull a class from the server and display source

commands.name: push
commands.description: Push a local class to the server and compile it

commands.name: production
commands.description: Generate, create, open, or manage a production

commands.name: host
commands.description: Add, update, remove, or list hosts in a production

commands.name: interview
commands.description: Guided questionnaire to build a requirements document

commands.name: build-poc
commands.description: Build a full POC from a requirements document

commands.name: poc
commands.description: Build a full POC (alias for /build-poc)

commands.name: json-adapter
commands.description: Generate JSON adapter classes from a payload structure

commands.name: web-app
commands.description: Create or manage a web application (REST, WSGI, CSP)

commands.name: dtl
commands.description: Create and test an HL7 Data Transformation

commands.name: rule
commands.description: Create an HL7 Routing Rule

commands.name: bpl
commands.description: Create a BPL visual business process

commands.name: lookup
commands.description: Create or update a lookup table

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send HL7 messages to an HTTP service

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Check recent message traces and event logs

commands.name: errors
commands.description: Pull error events from the event log

commands.name: test-suite
commands.description: Run all test messages for a package and check traces

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Static analysis on a production package

commands.name: diagram
commands.description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart of a production

commands.name: docx-to-md
commands.description: Convert a .docx document to Markdown

commands.name: cost
commands.description: Show token usage and cost estimates

commands.name: ipm
commands.description: Build or update an IPM package (module.xml, installer)

commands.name: ipm-install
commands.description: Install, verify, uninstall, or reset an IPM package from a local directory

commands.name: pip
commands.description: Install, list, or remove Python packages in IRIS embedded Python

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Delete a package from server, clear lookup tables

commands.name: reset-force
commands.description: Force-reset — skip dry run, delete immediately

commands.name: new-namespace
commands.description: Create a HealthShare Foundation namespace

commands.name: delete-namespace
commands.description: Delete a namespace and its database config

commands.name: reset-namespace
commands.description: Delete and recreate a namespace

commands.name: goto
commands.description: Navigate to a component (--dtl, --rule, --bpl, --trace)

commands.name: goto-reload
commands.description: Reload page then navigate to a component

commands.name: trace-view
commands.description: Open a message trace (optionally by session ID)

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Reload the page while preserving chat history

commands.name: model
commands.description: Change model — opus (capable), sonnet (balanced), haiku (fast)

commands.name: authenticate
commands.description: Set Bedrock API key — /authenticate <ABSK...>

commands.name: auth-status
commands.description: Check current authentication status

commands.name: feedback
commands.description: Submit feedback — /feedback [1-5] [category] <comment>

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show available commands

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear chat history and start fresh

commands.name: permissions
commands.description: View or set permission mode (strict, normal, permissive)

commands.name: goto-test
commands.description: Test navigation strategies (1-6 or all)

commands.name: git-token
commands.description: Configure GitLab token — /git-token <token> --url <url> --project <id>

commands.name: git-issue
commands.description: Create a GitLab issue — /git-issue <title>

commands.name: git-push
commands.description: Push files to a GitLab branch — /git-push <paths> [--branch name]
